title: Slumber a TUI HTTP Client
summary: Slumber is a terminal-based TUI HTTP client for making and testing API requests, providing a lightweight alternative to GUI tools like Postman or Insomnia. It allows developers to construct HTTP requests, view formatted responses, and manage collections directly from the terminal with keyboard-driven navigation.
problem_solved: Provides a lightweight, keyboard-driven alternative to GUI-based API testing tools for developers who prefer working in the terminal
why_valuable: Enables fast, portable API testing without heavy GUI dependencies, ideal for developers who spend most of their time in the terminal
